name: Heart
description: Heals a full red heart container.

name: Heart (half)
description: Heals a half red heart container.

name: Heart (soul)
description:
Adds a full soul heart.

Soul Hearts are added to the end of the health bar. They are not permanent; once lost, they cannot be replenished.

name: Heart (eternal)
description:
Grants an eternal heart.

Eternal hearts are placed on top of the second half of the last red heart container, or other heart container if Isaac has no red heart containers.

When carried to the next floor, or another one is picked up, the eternal heart becomes a permanent red heart container.

name: Heart (double)
description:
Heals 2 full red heart containers.

Has a 1/20 spawn rate in Normal Mode, and 1/50 in Hard Mode.

name: Black Heart
description:
Adds a full black heart.

When depleted, black hearts activate The Necronomicon effect, dealing 40 damage to all enemies in the room.

name: Gold Heart
description:
Adds a golden heart.

Golden hearts do not serve as any form of protection. They simply form an outline around the last heart in Isaac's health bar. When that heart is depleted, the golden heart will break and do the following:

• Drop 3-8 coins.

• Turn enemies near Isaac into gold for 6 seconds, similar to Midas' Touch. Golden enemies drop coins when killed.

When touched by The Lost or Tainted Lost, explodes into several coins akin to the Midas' Touch effect.

name: Heart (half soul)
description:
Adds a half soul heart.

Soul Hearts are added to the end of the health bar. They are not permanent; once lost, they cannot be replenished.

name: Scared Heart
description:
Heals a full red heart container.

Acts and looks identical to a normal Heart, but pulses faster and runs away from Isaac when approached.
unlock: Quick-restart by holding down the R button 7 times in a row.
unlock_text: Quick-restart by holding down the R button 7 times in a row.

name: Blended Heart
description:
Acts as either a Heart or Heart (soul) based on Isaac's current health.

If Isaac has an empty red heart container, it will refill one, otherwise it will add a soul heart.

If Isaac is missing only a half red heart container, it will fill it, and grant a half soul heart.

name: Bone Heart
description:
Adds an empty bone heart container.

Bone hearts can be refilled with red hearts, and take 3 hits to deplete.

When depleted, bone hearts break and cannot be regenerated.

If obtained as a character that cannot have red health, the bone heart cannot be filled and will break in 1 hit.

name: Rotten Heart
description:
Fills a whole red heart container, causing it to be depleted in just 1 hit.

Each rotten heart spawns 2 Blue Flies upon clearing a room.

Cannot be picked up by characters that cannot have red health.
unlock: Enter the Corpse for the first time.
unlock_text: Enter the Corpse for the first time.

name: Lucky Penny
unlock_text: Donate 2!c! to the Greed Donation Machine.

name: Sticky Nickel
description:
+5¢.

Cannot be picked up unless blasted off with an explosion.

name: Golden Penny
description:
+1¢.

Spawns another golden penny in a random spot in the same room after being picked up, but has a 10% chance of disappearing instead.
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Keeper.

name: Key
description: +1 key.

name: Golden Key
description: Grants infinite keys for the rest of the floor.

name: Key Ring
description: +2 keys.

name: Charged Key
description:
+1 key.

Adds 6 charges to Isaac's active item.

name: Bomb
description:
+1 bomb.

Bombs can be placed down with a keybind (default: E). They explode after 1.5 seconds and deal 100 damage to nearby enemies.

Bombs deal a full heart of damage to Isaac.

name: Double Bomb
description: +2 bombs.

name: Troll Bomb
description:
Spawns ignited and explodes after 1.5-2.5 seconds.

The bomb deals 100 damage to enemies, and a full heart of damage to Isaac.

Cannot be picked up.

synergies.description: Converts it into a Bomb before exploding.

name: Golden Bomb
description: Grants infinite bombs for the rest of the floor.

name: Megatroll Bomb
description:
Spawns ignited and explodes after 1.5-2.5 seconds, whilst homing in on Isaac if he is close enough.

The bomb deals 100 damage to enemies, and a full heart of damage to Isaac.

Cannot be picked up.

synergies.description: Converts it into a Double Bomb before exploding.

name: Golden Troll Bomb
description:
Spawns ignited and explodes infinitely, once every 3 seconds.

The bomb deals 100 damage to enemies, and a full heart of damage to Isaac.

Cannot be picked up.

synergies.description: Converts it into a Golden Bomb before exploding.

name: Giga Bomb
description:
+1 giga bomb. This is indicated by the bomb indicator in the HUD appearing with a giga bomb icon.

It can be placed down like a normal bomb that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 300 damage to nearby enemies, and a full heart of damage to Isaac.

The explosion destroys 13 tiles in a diamond shape, creating holes in the ground. These holes cannot be created in such a way that paths to doors in the room become blocked, including Secret Room entrances.

The explosion also scatters around big rock pebbles across the room that deal 15 damage to enemies, and 99 damage to enemies standing close to the explosion. These rocks cannot hurt Isaac.

name: Throwable Bomb (pickup)
description:
Once picked up, immediately ignites and explodes after 1.5 seconds. Can be thrown with the fire buttons while held.

Deals 100 damage to enemies, and a full heart of damage to Isaac.

Spawned by Bomb Grimaces.

name: Poop Nugget
description:
Drops from Tainted ??? while dealing damage to enemies, and only has an effect when playing as this character.

Adds 1 poop nugget to the inventory.

name: Big Poop Nugget
description:
Every bomb spawned when playing as Tainted ??? gets replaced with this, and only has an effect when playing as this character.

Adds 3 poop nuggets to the inventory.

name: Chest
description:
Does not have a requirement to open.


Possible drops

• 1-3 coins

• Bomb

• Key

• Heart

• Trinket

• Pill

• A smaller chest with new contents

name: Bomb Chest
description:
Requires an explosion to open.

Has the same contents as a Locked Chest.

name: Spiked Chest
description:
Requires half a heart of damage to open.

Has the same contents as a regular Chest.

name: Eternal Chest
description:
Requires a key to open.

Has the same contents as a Locked Chest.

Once opened, it will close itself after 2 seconds, generating new content, but after the first time it's been opened, it has a 25% chance to give nothing and stay open, making it no longer usable.

The chest will also stay open if it contains an item, making it its final payout.

name: Mimic Chest
description:
Turns into a Spiked Chest when Isaac gets too close, requiring half a heart of damage to open.

Has the same contents as a regular Chest.

When the chest converts into a Spiked Chest, the contents inside it change.

synergies.description: Prevents the chest from converting into a Spiked Chest when approached.

name: Old Chest
description:
Requires a key to open.

Possible drops

• 43% - 1-3 soul hearts

• 42% - 3 trinkets

• 10% - item from the Old Chest item pool

• 5% - item from the Angel Room item pool

name: Wooden Chest
description:
Does not have a requirement to open.

Possible drops

• 45% - 2 cards/runes

• 45% - 2-3 pills

• 10% - item from the Wooden Chest item pool
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Lazarus.

name: Mega Chest
description:
Requires 1-7 keys to open.

Has a 1% chance to replace any Locked Chest.

Possible drops

• 2 items from the Treasure Room item pool

• The contents of 5 Locked Chests (excluding items)
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Isaac.

name: Haunted Chest
description:
When approached, a Polty ghost comes out of the chest and throws it at Isaac, after which it opens. The chest deals half a heart of damage if touched before being open, and when thrown.

If Isaac leaves the room while the ghost is carrying it, it will disappear.

Has the contents of a regular Chest.
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Lost.

name: Locked Chest
description:
Requires a key to open.

Possible drops

• 58% - 2-6 random pickups

• 20% - Item from the Golden Chest item pool

• 10% - Trinket

• 10% - Card

• 1% - A smaller regular chest with new contents

• 1% - A smaller locked chest with new contents

synergies.description: Increases the amount of pickups spawned by 1.
Changes the drop chances: 80% for random pickups, and 20% for an item.

name: Red Chest
description:
Does not have a requirement to open.

Possible drops

• 15% - 2 Troll Bombs

• 15% - 2 pills

• 13% - 2 enemy Spiders/Striders

• 13% - Megatroll Bomb

• 10% - item from the Red Chest item pool

• 7.5% - 1 Soul Heart

• 7.5% - 2 Soul Hearts

• 7% - 3 Blue Flies

• 7% - 3 Blue Spiders

• 5% - teleport to the Devil/Angel Room (0% chance if opened inside a Devil/Angel Room)

name: Mom's Chest
description:
Does not have a requirement to open.

Cannot be duplicated with any item.

Contains Red Key when opened for the first time, or an item from the Mom's Chest item pool otherwise.

Spawns in Mom's room in the Home level.

name: Grab Bag
description:
Spawns 1-4 random pickups when touched:

• 35% → key.

• 27% → coin.

• 26% → bomb.

• 7% → card/rune.

• 6% → battery.

Can be sold for 7¢ in shops.

name: Black Sack
description:
Spawns 2-3 of the following when touched:

• 35% → random pill.

• 35% → random bomb.

• 20% → Black Heart.

• 10% → Bone Heart.

Only 1 heart can spawn per sack.

Has a 1% chance to replace any regular Grab Bag.
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Judas.

name: Lil' Battery
description: Adds 6 charges to Isaac's active item.

name: Micro Battery
description: Adds 2 charges to Isaac's active item.

name: Mega Battery
description:
Fully charges Isaac's active item, and adds an entire overcharge.

Holding multiple active items will charge all of them twice.

name: Golden Battery
description:
Adds 6 charges to Isaac's active item.

Deals a full heart of damage to Isaac.

Respawns in a random room on the floor when picked up, however it does not show up on the map until found again.
unlock_text: Defeat Mega Satan as Tainted Forgotten.
